title: net2 on another net1: r18e05 unchanged on net1 v6 seeds 1 and 2 (H4, H5)
description: r18e05 passed its gate and its test on net1 v6 seed 0 (exp-net2-gate-r18e05-s11-167, exp-net2-test-r18e05-168). If net2 acts on what net1's beliefs mean and on nothing else (H4), it should keep its gain on another net1 that means the same: net1 v6's seeds 1 and 2 (release exp-net1v6-149) share seed 0's LCFs, bin boundaries and input scaler. This runs r18e05 on seed 0 and, unchanged, on seeds 1 and 2 (release model-net2-v6-swap), next to the fixed rule on each seed (u = 0.25) and BBRv3, on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, campaign seed 11 as at the gate, and scores each against the rule on each seed (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py). It also bears on H5: a net1 can be replaced without retraining net2.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/w" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); for n in 0 1 2; do uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule6-$n" "$IN/v6/net1-v6-s$n/net1.pt" --u 0.25; done; P=(--policy "rule-v6=$OUT/rule6-0/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v6n1=$OUT/rule6-1/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v6n2=$OUT/rule6-2/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "ppo-r18e05-s0=$IN/c/ppo-r18e05-s0.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/w/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && for r in rule-v6 rule-v6n1 rule-v6n2; do uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT" "$r" && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-$r.md" && mv "$OUT/gate.json" "$OUT/gate-$r.json"; done && cat "$OUT/against-rule-v6.md" "$OUT/against-rule-v6n1.md" "$OUT/against-rule-v6n2.md" > "$OUT/summary.md"
